info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Deposit Lending By Param1-spec
info.description: This API allows for the modification of deposit lending details in a current account by referencing a specific parameter. It serves a critical role for financial institutions that need to dynamically update account information in response to changing customer circumstances or policy updates. Typical consumers include bank representatives or financial advisors who manage customer accounts and seek to enhance lending terms. By utilizing this endpoint, users can ensure that deposit lending information remains accurate and up-to-date, thereby improving customer service and compliance.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of the specified current account under deposit lending. Ensure that you provide all necessary fields in the request body to reflect the desired changes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the current account details for the specified account number (ACC-200045) within the deposit lending system. Ensure that all required fields are provided in the payload to avoid validation errors.

200.description: The request was processed successfully, and the current account details have been updated.
